27	  - Son: **Duncan Keddie** (b. 1894, author of 1968 account at age 74)
28	    - Daughter: **Ivy Keddie** (b. 1931, Duncan's daughter; Ansel's granddaughter)
29	
30	- **Emmet Brant** (Orra's brother; Hessel Bottom farmer):
31	  - Kept weigh book, January 1, 1897 to death 1929
32	  - Son: **Roy Brant** (inherited weigh book; lent it to Ivy 1958; died 1962)
33	    - Daughter: **Hazel Brant** (received weigh book from Roy's estate; gave to Historical Rooms 1963)
34	
35	- **Second-cousin relationship:** Ivy Keddie and Hazel Brant (children of first cousins Duncan and Roy)
36

38	- **Discovery:** February 1958 (Ivy Keddie)
39	- **Location found:** Loft over intake room (placed there 1923)
40	- **Measurement:** Sent to Farland, returned
41	- **Deposition:** 1959, Historical Rooms at Ordell County (with test book)

44	- "Mrs. Cudd's test book has this year gone to the Vessey County Historical Society, and the five books are now in three buildings and are none of them ours."
45	- Rosalie Cudd's test book transferred to Vessey County 1970 (1959 copy of Jerome Cudd's factory records)
46	- Five documents now dispersed: Ostrey Hollow test book (Ordell Historical Rooms), Brant weigh book (Ordell Historical Rooms after 1963), Strawn circuit notebooks (Farland library), Cudd test book (Vessey County), and one unaccounted (possibly Ivy's analysis/measurements)
47

51	3. **Strawn Circuit Notebooks** (state dairy inspector, one per year; retired 1936 to state dairy office; 1947 to State Agricultural College library Farland; Ivy found 1923 volume ~1958)
52	4. **Cudd Test Book** (Jerome Cudd, cheese factory Alder Corners; daughter Rosalie Cudd 1941; figures copied 1958 sent to Ivy at college; original "never out of Vessey County"; 1970 to Vessey County Historical Society)
